svg.title: Hamilton-path signed-weight construction
svg.desc: Two examples for n=8. Left: a cycle of positions, including the dashed closing pair. Right: the corresponding Hamilton path on vertex labels, with no closing edge. Shading marks positions occupied by labels 1, 2, 3 or those labels themselves. Ordering (1,2,4,5,6,7,8,3) has A={1,2,8}, k=2, w=1/8, ordering weight 1/5760, and one triangle edge. Ordering (1,4,2,5,3,6,7,8) has A={1,3,5}, k=0, w=-1/16, ordering weight -1/11520, and no triangle edge. These are signed weights, not probabilities.
